notes: Construct kol before the substantival participle merim was given the supplied antecedent 'one', while 35.10, 35.21, 35.22 and 35.29 all give construct kol only its own quantifier word and let the substantive it governs take the supplied noun. Rule 46 puts the antecedent-plus-relative on the bare participle, as this chapter does twice at 35.35. Moved t002 from s001 to s002; the head of s002 stays on the lexeme-bearing 'offer'.
